description:
Rewrite the short-id lease records in this checkout's machine-local claims log to full issue ids, so the log decodes once lease issue ids are validated.

## Background

The claims log `.git/jit/claims.jsonl` is machine-local and gitignored. This checkout's log holds 26 acquire records whose `issue_id` is an 8-character short id; its five active leases in `claims.index.json` are canonical. The current code accepts full-id lease records and resolves short-id records through a tolerance path (`crates/jit/src/storage/claim_coordinator.rs:294,806`), so rewriting the short ids to the full ids they resolve to changes no lease outcome.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each acquire record in this checkout's claims log whose issue id is a short id names the full id of the issue it resolves to, and records that resolve to no issue are dropped.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every record in the log has a canonical issue id, and lease-enforced commands and repository validation succeed afterwards.
- [hard] REQ-03: No code changes, and no compatibility reader is added.

## Notes

Other checkouts with short-id records are rewritten the same way; the log is not repository content (`@/inv/canonical-cutover`).
title: This checkout's claims log names issues by full id
